# Справка Wolfram: local

Сохранённая внешняя документация. Копия адаптирована для переносимости: локальные пути и демонстрационные реквизиты/объекты заменены параметрами; содержимое не является конфигурацией готового аккаунта. Она описывает продукты, версии и варианты доступа, а не состояние какого-либо аккаунта. Примеры ОС, тарифов, путей и лимитов выбираются по целевой установке; числовые условия проверяются у поставщика перед использованием. Даты и исходная терминология могут относиться к версии справки.

# Wolfram Local MCP

Give LLM Systems Agentic Access to Installed Wolfram Applications

Wolfram Local MCP gives agentic access to installed Wolfram applications, allowing them to power Wolfram Foundation Tool capabilities.

<div class="buttons">

<a href="/artificial-intelligence/mcp/local/wolfram-mcp-local/" class="button" data-walid="">Connect Now</a> Read about <a href="//writings.stephenwolfram.com/2026/06/launching-version-15-of-wolfram-language-mathematica-built-in-useful-ai-lots-of-new-core-functionality/" class="chevron-after" data-walid="">what's new in Version 15</a>

</div>

</div>

<div id="using" class="section">

<div class="content">

<div>

## Using Local MCP with AI Coding Tools

Using Wolfram Local MCP, AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Visual Studio Code can connect to installed Wolfram applications. The AI coding assistant can evaluate Wolfram Language code, search Wolfram documentation, read and write notebooks, run tests and inspect code.

<div class="highlighter">

**Free with:** [Wolfram Engine](https://www.wolfram.com/engine/) [Wolfram\|One](https://www.wolfram.com/wolfram-one/) [Mathematica](https://www.wolfram.com/mathematica/)

**Works with:** Antigravity ChatGPT Claude Code Claude Desktop Cline Codex Continue Cursor Kiro LibreChat OpenCode Roo Windsurf Zed Any client that supports MCP

</div>

<div id="set-apart" class="section">

<div class="content">

## The Power of Wolfram Technology

<div class="pod">

<img src="../img/apart-icon-computed-results.svg" width="55" />

<div>

### Accurate computed results, not hallucinations

With the Wolfram Foundation Tool, you're using the power of Wolfram symbolic computation to compute accurate results, free from LLM-related issues such as hallucinations.

</div>

</div>

<div class="pod">

<img src="../img/apart-icon-computation.svg" width="55" />

<div>

### Open-ended custom computation, not document retrieval

The Foundation Tool efficiently computes exactly what you need—whether or not it has ever been computed before—rather than trying to find a precomputed result in an existing document.

</div>

</div>

<div class="pod">

<img src="../img/apart-icon-curated.svg" width="55" />

<div>

### Curated Wolfram data, not web crawls

The Foundation Tool accesses the Wolfram Knowledgebase—authoritative data curated over the past two decades—not material scraped from websites.

</div>

</div>

<div class="pod">

<img src="../img/apart-icon-tool-input.svg" width="55" />

<div>

### Transparent tool input, not black-box code

Results are backed by highly readable Wolfram Language and Wolfram\|Alpha input that can readily be validated by users.

</div>

</div>

<div class="pod trusted">

<img src="../img/apart-icon-trusted-results.svg" width="55" />

<div>

### Trusted Wolfram results, not AI slop

The Foundation Tool gives you access to the same Wolfram technology that's been trusted by the world's R&D leaders for more than three decades. <a href="/language/newest/" class="chevron-after">Learn about what's new in the latest version</a>

</div>

</div>

<a href="/artificial-intelligence/foundation-tool" class="button btn-outline">Learn More</a>

</div>

</div>

</div>

<div id="q-and-a" class="section">

<div class="content">

## Wolfram Local MCP Q&A

<div class="question-group">

### Getting Started

<div class="question" itemscope="" itemprop="mainEntity" itemtype="https://schema.org/Question">

#### What do I need to use Wolfram Local MCP?

<div itemscope="" itemprop="acceptedAnswer" itemtype="https://schema.org/Answer">

Wolfram Local MCP requires [Wolfram\|One, Mathematica or a licensed Wolfram Engine](https://www.wolfram.com/get-products-services/).

</div>

</div>

<div class="question" itemscope="" itemprop="mainEntity" itemtype="https://schema.org/Question">

#### What is the difference between Wolfram Local MCP and Wolfram Cloud MCP?

<div itemscope="" itemprop="acceptedAnswer" itemtype="https://schema.org/Answer">

Wolfram Local MCP allows you to get the most out of the Wolfram product you already have installed. It allows for complex, multistep interactions using Wolfram Language driven by your preferred AI harness along with access to expert-level answers using Wolfram's algorithms and knowledgebase. If you have a licensed Wolfram Engine, Mathematica or Wolfram\|One, you already have access to Wolfram Local MCP. [Wolfram Cloud MCP](https://www.wolfram.com/artificial-intelligence/mcp/cloud/) is a free service that connects your MCP-compatible application to Wolfram technology.

</div>

</div>

<div class="question" itemscope="" itemprop="mainEntity" itemtype="https://schema.org/Question">

#### Do I need any additional subscriptions to use Wolfram Local MCP?

<div itemscope="" itemprop="acceptedAnswer" itemtype="https://schema.org/Answer">

No additional subscriptions are required.

</div>

</div>

<div class="question" itemscope="" itemprop="mainEntity" itemtype="https://schema.org/Question">

#### Can I use the Wolfram Local MCP with an AI client that isn't listed in the documentation?

<div itemscope="" itemprop="acceptedAnswer" itemtype="https://schema.org/Answer">

Yes. For MCP-compatible clients not listed in the documentation, you can generate the raw JSON configuration and adapt it manually.

</div>

</div>

</div>

<div class="question-group">

### Troubleshooting

<div class="question" itemscope="" itemprop="mainEntity" itemtype="https://schema.org/Question">

#### I'm not seeing Wolfram tools in my chat client after following the documentation. What do I do now?

<div itemscope="" itemprop="acceptedAnswer" itemtype="https://schema.org/Answer">

- Fully restart your chat client after installing—closing the window often just minimizes it to the system tray.
- Inspect the configuration of MCP servers for your client. If you want to see what Wolfram knows about a given client, you can use `PacletSymbol["Wolfram/AgentTools", "DeployedAgentTools"][]`.
- Check your client's documentation for the location of log files and check for errors.
- If none of these solve the problem, you can visit the [Support Center](https://support.wolfram.com) for more assistance.

</div>

</div>

<div class="question" itemscope="" itemprop="mainEntity" itemtype="https://schema.org/Question">

#### Why did my computation time out?

<div itemscope="" itemprop="acceptedAnswer" itemtype="https://schema.org/Answer">

The default setting for evaluations is 60 seconds. For long-running computations, you can ask the AI to increase the timeout setting or break your computation into smaller steps.

</div>

</div>

<div class="question" itemscope="" itemprop="mainEntity" itemtype="https://schema.org/Question">

#### Why is Wolfram Local MCP using a different version of Wolfram Language?

<div itemscope="" itemprop="acceptedAnswer" itemtype="https://schema.org/Answer">

The installed Wolfram Local MCP will use the same version of Wolfram Language as the session it was installed from. If you want to use a different version of Wolfram Language, you need to install Local MCP in a session of that version or manually edit the configuration file to point to a different Wolfram kernel.

</div>

</div>

<div class="question" itemscope="" itemprop="mainEntity" itemtype="https://schema.org/Question">

#### Why aren't the results I'm getting closer to what I'm looking for?

<div itemscope="" itemprop="acceptedAnswer" itemtype="https://schema.org/Answer">

The documentation for [Local MCP](https://www.wolfram.com/artificial-intelligence/mcp/local/wolfram-mcp-local/) contains many best practices for working with agents via MCP. For your chat clients, be sure to look at [Persistent Instructions](https://www.wolfram.com/artificial-intelligence/mcp/local/wolfram-mcp-local/#persistent-instructions) and [Tips for Best Results](https://www.wolfram.com/artificial-intelligence/mcp/local/wolfram-mcp-local/#tips-for-best-results). Tips for working with AI coding assistants can be found in [Best Practices](https://www.wolfram.com/artificial-intelligence/mcp/local/wolfram-mcp-local/#best-practices) and [Configuring AI Guidance with AGENTS.md](https://www.wolfram.com/artificial-intelligence/mcp/local/wolfram-mcp-local/#configuring-ai-guidance).

</div>

</div>

</div>

</div>

</div>
